name: handoff-doc-discipline
description: Always-on lifecycle discipline for a living handoff/resume document: preserve the prior version before overwriting it in place, and re-read it linearly for self-contradiction before dispatching it.

source.title: Handoff Document Discipline Baseline
source.relationship: Distilled from 2026-07 sessions where a wholesale in-place overwrite of a living plan doc discarded the only copy of a prior design, and a long handoff doc accumulated additive corrections that contradicted earlier sections.
